Life at Claroty

Want to learn more about what it's like to work with us? Get to know our team members across each region and hear directly from them about what makes Claroty a truly special place.

People First

We put each other ahead of work, knowing that if we care for each other, the results will follow.

Integrity

We hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards of professionalism, ethics, and integrity.

Strive for Excellence

We dedicate ourselves to Claroty, our customers, our partners, and each other.

Customer Obsession

We take an outside-in approach in everything we do, orienting our ideas, actions, and behaviors around our customer business problems and the outcomes they strive to achieve.

A Worldwide Team

With a hybrid workforce and offices in New York City, Tel Aviv-Yafo, London, Munich, Singapore, Seoul, and Melbourne, our team is growing fast. But no matter where you call home, there’s a place for you here.
